title: Nasal Cauterization Setup
desc: MA setup checklist for chemical and electrical cautery procedures and patient discharge instructions.

blocks.content: Obtain signed consent form first — locate it in the PDF manager in the EMR, searchable under "cauterization"
Silver nitrate sticks on tray (75% silver nitrate applicator)
Topical anesthetic ready — lidocaine or tetracaine on cotton pledgets
1% or 2% lidocaine with epinephrine 1:100,000 drawn and labeled
Surgicel cut to 1.5 cm × 1.5 cm — mupirocin ointment applied to one side
Electrocautery unit powered on and tested before provider enters
Grounding pad placed on patient back or thigh (monopolar only)
Nasal gel spray to keep the area moist
No strenuous activity, massage, or chiropractic manipulation
